svg.title: The decision held; the explanation moved
svg.desc: For each of three hard positives, the analyzer tier and construct labels on the original conversation and six rewordings, with the assistant turns as written and replaced by neutral acknowledgments. The tier is review in every cell; several construct labels move between present and uncertain.
svg.text: The decision held; the explanation moved
Analyzer output on 3 hard positives, original and six rewordings. One cell = one label on one conversation.
Rows: constructs not absent in gold or in any output. Transforms in design order, not ranked.
